latest.title: The Silent Killer of Cloud Deployments: Why Your AI Coding Agent is Breaking Your Infrastructure (And How to Fix It)
latest.description:
If you have been building applications or cloud architectures using AI coding agents this year, you already know the incredible speed they bring. You ask your agent to spin up a secure cloud pipeline, configure a database container, or write an infrastructure-as-code script, and it delivers hundreds of lines of code in seconds.

Then, you run your deployment—and everything crashes. 🚨

You spend the next two hours digging through documentation just to fix a deprecated API parameter .

latest.title: Building a Serverless REST API with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB
latest.description: Learn how to build a scalable serverless REST API using Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. This article explains the complete request flow, API design, Lambda functions, database operations, IAM security, error handling, monitoring with CloudWatch, and best practices for building reliable cloud-native applications without managing traditional servers.

latest.title: Building a Serverless Image Processing Pipeline with Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda
latest.description: Learn how Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda can work together to automatically process images when they are uploaded. This beginner-friendly walkthrough explains the architecture, real-world use cases, Lambda code, event-driven processing, scalability, and important security considerations.

latest.title: AWS Client VPN Explained: Secure Remote Access to AWS VPC Resources
latest.description:
Modern organizations do not have every employee working from the corporate office.

Developers, cloud engineers, administrators, and remote employees may need secure access to applications and resources hosted inside AWS VPCs.

latest.title: Mastering AWS IAM Security
latest.description: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) is the central control plane for securing your AWS environment. It determines exactly who can access what, and under which conditions. To secure modern cloud architectures, builders must move away from shared credentials and embrace a "Zero Trust" model rooted in the Principle of Least Privilege.
